product_overview: A personal blog website where visitors can browse and read published articles. Authenticated users can manage articles, categories, notifications, and profile settings from a protected admin panel.
core_goals: Let visitors read published blog posts.
Let users sign up, log in, and manage their profile.
Let authenticated users create, edit, draft, and publish articles with images.
Connect the frontend to the Express backend APIs for posts and auth.

features.name: Browse articles
features.description: Visitors can view published blog posts, filter them by category, search, and open an article detail page from the home screen.
user_flows: Open the home page -> Browse article cards -> Filter articles by category -> Type in the search box -> Open an article card to view the detail page

features.name: View post detail
features.description: Visitors can read a full article, interact with likes and comments, and are prompted to log in before interacting when needed.
user_flows: Open an article from the home page -> Read the title, content, and metadata -> Like the article -> Type a comment -> Send the comment -> See a login prompt when not authenticated

features.name: User login
features.description: Users can log in with email and password and are returned to the home page after successful authentication.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the home page

features.name: User signup
features.description: New users can register an account and are then shown a confirmation page.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Fill in the registration fields -> Submit the signup form -> See the registration success page

features.name: Admin article management
features.description: Authenticated users can manage articles in the admin area by searching, creating, editing, drafting, and publishing posts.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/articles while logged out -> See redirection to /login
Log in -> Navigate to /admin/articles -> Search or filter articles in the admin list
Navigate to /admin/articles/create -> Fill in the article details -> Upload a valid image -> Save the article as a draft
Navigate to /admin/articles/create -> Fill in the article details -> Upload a valid image -> Publish the article
Navigate to /admin/articles/:articleId/edit -> Update the article details -> Save the changes

features.name: Admin categories
features.description: Authenticated users can create and edit blog categories from the admin panel.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/categories -> View the category list
Navigate to /admin/categories/create -> Fill in the category details -> Submit the form
Navigate to /admin/categories/:categoryId/edit -> Update the category details -> Submit the form

features.name: Admin profile and password
features.description: Authenticated users can update their profile information and change their password.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/profile -> Edit profile fields -> Save the profile changes
Navigate to /admin/reset-password -> Fill in the current password -> Fill in the new password -> Submit the password change form

features.name: Admin notifications
features.description: Authenticated users can open the notifications area and review notification items.

features.name: Health check page
features.description: Users can manually test the backend health endpoint and inspect the response on the page.
user_flows: Navigate to /test-health -> Trigger the health check test -> See the response status and JSON output

routes.description: Public blog home with hero, category filter, search, and article list
Public article detail with likes and comments
User login with email and password
Protected admin shell that redirects to article management
Admin list of articles with search and status filters
Create article with image upload, draft or publish
Edit existing article and sync numeric IDs to backend

features.name: Browse articles
features.description: Visitors can view published blog posts, filter by category, search, and paginate from the home page
user_interactions: Click an article card to open the detail page

features.name: View post detail
features.description: Visitors can read a full article, like it, and comment; unauthenticated users are prompted to log in
user_interactions: Type a comment and click Send
See login dialog when not authenticated

features.description: Login with email and password, store access token, then redirect home
user_interactions: See error toast on invalid credentials
Get redirected to home on success

features.name: User signup
features.description: Register a new account then show a success page

features.name: Admin article management
features.description: Authenticated users can list, create, and edit articles; create uploads an image to the backend and edit updates numeric posts via PUT

Create an article with title, category, content, image, draft or publish
Edit an existing article and save
Search or filter articles in the admin list

features.name: Admin categories
features.description: Manage blog categories from the admin panel using local category store

features.name: Admin profile and password
features.description: Update profile fields and reset password for the logged-in user

features.name: Health check page
features.description: Manual page that calls backend GET /health and shows the response
user_interactions: See success JSON or error status

known_limitations.issue: Categories, notifications, and some article list state still live in local stores rather than always reading from the backend
known_limitations.impact: Admin lists can diverge from posts stored in the API

known_limitations.issue: Auth falls back to a local in-memory/localStorage store when the remote API is unavailable
known_limitations.impact: Login and register can succeed locally without hitting the real backend

known_limitations.issue: Comments and likes on the post detail page are primarily UI interactions
known_limitations.impact: Engagement may not persist if corresponding APIs are missing
